findings.body: Reference mutations are committed before `loadFinancialWorkbook` resolves all mappings and calls `activateGeneration`. If reference indexing, mapping resolution, or activation then fails, these inserts and `ON CONFLICT ... DO UPDATE` changes remain; updates to shared plant/GL names and aliases can alter the still-active generation. Reference preparation and generation activation need one transaction (or otherwise must not mutate active shared references before successful activation).
findings.title: Not done: failed replacement retains the prior generation

findings.body: The loader unconditionally records `reconciled: true` without comparing the source net totals with debit-minus-credit totals or verifying persisted destination sums. A workbook with inconsistent source net cells can therefore be sent for activation and reported as reconciled. The required independent reconciliation must perform the comparison and reject activation on mismatch; the current positive-only test does not exercise this failure.
findings.title: Not done: independent source reconciliation

findings.body: The purported activation test replaces the production repository with a callback that always returns `activated: true`. It therefore cannot detect broken CLI-to-repository wiring, a non-atomic activation, failed-replacement damage, or incorrect persisted coverage/month metadata. The required activation evidence needs to exercise the real loader entry point and repository against the guarded disposable database, while faking only external services.
findings.title: Not done: coverage/activation and month-set evidence

findings.body: This new file is outside every permitted path and contains only branch workflow state (`working`/`start`), so it is not needed to implement or test the operator loader. Its presence contradicts the handoff claim that there are no unnecessary out-of-scope changes and should be removed from this branch.
findings.title: Remove the out-of-scope task-state artifact
